name: Via negativa

phase_0.boundary_condition: The limit of human conceptualization and linguistic expression

VINIT.justification: The unconditioned reality prior to any predication or naming

TANCH.justification: The final state where all conceptual noise ceases and the system closes

AFWD.justification: The initial movement of attributing qualities to the divine or absolute

AREV.justification: The systematic removal of attributes to approach the truth by what it is not

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of negations to refine the understanding

IMSCRIB.justification: The recognition that the observer must also be negated to reach the object

FSPLIT.justification: The division of a concept into its positive attribute and its negation

FFUSE.justification: The reunification of the concept and its negation into a higher non-dual understanding

EVALT.justification: The successful realization of what the object is not

EVALF.justification: The failure to negate a concept, resulting in a false positive fixation

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of affirmation and negation in mystical union

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the realization that the truth exceeds all language

phase_3.void_description: The pre-conceptual state of pure potentiality without definition
phase_3.true_description: The realization of the absolute through the successful negation of all finite attributes
phase_3.false_description: The attachment to a finite attribute as if it were the absolute
phase_3.both_description: The paradoxical state where the absolute is seen as both everything and nothing simultaneously

steps.domain_action: The Absolute exists in a state of unmanifested potentiality
The Absolute is identified as the starting point of the inquiry
The mind attributes the quality of Goodness to the Absolute
The attribution of Goodness is recorded as a conceptual starting point
The concept of Goodness is split into its finite definition and its negation
The finite definition of Goodness is systematically negated
The mind rejects the finite definition as insufficient for the Absolute
The mind accepts the negation as a closer approximation of truth
The affirmation and negation are synthesized into a non-conceptual awareness
The process moves to the next attribute of Wisdom
The mind attributes the quality of Wisdom to the Absolute
The concept of Wisdom is split into its finite definition and its negation
The finite definition of Wisdom is systematically negated
The mind rejects the finite definition of Wisdom
The mind accepts the negation of Wisdom
The synthesis of Wisdom and its negation is achieved
The mind holds the paradox that the Absolute is neither Good nor not-Good
The observer recognizes their own conceptual framework as a barrier
The observer negates their own role in the process of naming
The realization of the limits of language is permanently recorded
The process concludes in the silence of the ineffable

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The intellect performing the work of discrimination and negation
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The logical tension between affirmative and negative propositions
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The cumulative history of negated concepts within the contemplative tradition
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The stages of the mystical ascent or the logical order of the via negativa
phase_5.alfs_store: The Corpus Areopagiticum or similar foundational apophatic texts

phase_6.cycle_cost: The cognitive effort required to dismantle conceptual structures
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A mind filled with positive conceptual definitions of the absolute
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A mind emptied of concepts, residing in a state of learned ignorance
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy spent in negation is balanced by the reduction in conceptual complexity
